text:
The court will most likely uphold the statute as constitutional. Under the Anderson-Burdick balancing test, the state's interest in an orderly ballot and in recognizing established parties outweighs a burden that closely tracks requirements upheld in *Jenness v. Fortson* (5% petitions, 180-day circulation) and *Storer v. Brown*. The 7% figure is the most vulnerable element, but it is not clearly beyond what those cases allowed.

CONFIDENCE: 65
